clips.title: The story
paras: Splithoof Crag is a fortified settlement of the Galak centaur, tucked along the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles. It serves as one of the tribe's major enclaves alongside the high mesas, guarding the entrance to Splithoof Hold. Travelers traversing the canyon floor must contend with aggressive Galak patrols roaming near the bluffs.

Nestled against the sheer northern rock face of Thousand Needles, Splithoof Crag sits just east of the towering Darkcloud Pinnacle. It is an established enclave of the Galak centaur, complete with crude tent encampments and dirt pathways cutting through the crags. At the heart of the village against the cliffside lies Splithoof Hold, a subterranean cavern holding the Cloven Hoof, an ancient relic of the centaur safeguarded by a sacred brazier.

The Galak fiercely contest this corner of the canyon, clashing with any travelers, Horde expeditions, or tauren scouting parties wandering beneath their bluffs. While the Grimtotem occupy the soaring pinnacles nearby, the centaur hold firm control of this canyon ravine and the caverns burrowed deep beneath the stone.
